anchor_value: USD-denominated amortized cost/fair value source columns

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Company (1)(6) | Investment | Initial Acquisition Date | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate | Amortized Cost (2)(8) | Fair Value (9) | Percentage of Net Assets

rationale: FX03 fired because cost_currency was stored as U_USD, but the raw SOI presents the flagged valuation fields in the amortized cost and fair value columns of a dollar-denominated BDC investment schedule. A representative foreign-par row keeps CAD only in the instrument par and parenthetical local fair value while the extracted amortized cost is the schedule valuation amount, so U_USD denotes the USD XBRL unit rather than a non-USD cost currency.
